description: Optimize the hexagonal P6_3mc bulk structure of gallium nitride.
user_prompt: Optimize the hexagonal (P6_3mc) bulk structure of gallium nitride (GaN). Report the final converged energy and lattice constants.

references: Jain, Ong, Hautier, Chen, Richards, Dacek, Cholia, Gunter, Skinner, Ceder & Persson, APL Mater. 1, 011002 (2013)
method.modeling: Wurtzite GaN hexagonal bulk cell with space group P6_3mc; GaN formula unit is one Ga and one N atom.
method.rationale: The target energy is the Materials Project mp-804 uncorrected GGA final energy per atom (-6.1586 eV/atom) multiplied by two atoms per GaN formula unit. Only the total energy is scored; the lattice constants are left as diagnostics, with the relaxed MP structure close to the Schulz-Thiemann wurtzite reference. The +/-0.5 eV/f.u. absolute tolerance covers PAW dataset, cutoff, smearing, and Ga semicore-valence differences while still flagging qualitatively wrong bulk calculations.
